by: claude: tax back-fill 2015 onward, the four taxes the ten-year report reads (Germany)
note: Germany tax years 2015 to 2025 (calendar), from PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries copies dated inside each year (review date in each note). The capital gains rows carry the investor's allowance as the threshold (€801 to 2022, €1,000 from 2023), which the stored 2026 row lacks. Rows from 2026 were already on file.

rates.thr_note: Investor's allowance (Sparer-Pauschbetrag) of €801 per person a year for all investment income together (doubled for joint filers).
rates.note: Flat tax (Abgeltungsteuer) on capital gains from financial investments: 25% plus 5.5% solidarity surcharge, plus church tax if applicable (PwC states 25% plus solidarity surcharge; 26.375% = 25% x 1.055 (the 5.5% surcharge on the tax, stated by PwC from 2022 and by EY); last reviewed 19 Jan 2015). The 2026 row has no allowance stored; this history row does.
